summary: Elevra Lithium, an Australian foreign private issuer formerly named Sayona Mining, furnished a Form 6-K with exhibits filed on the ASX: an Appendix 3G notice covering 132,928 ordinary fully paid shares issued on 4 November 2026 upon exercise/conversion of ELVAM performance rights issued under an employee incentive scheme, an Appendix 3H cessation of securities notice, and a corporate presentation on North American lithium supply. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. This is routine equity administration and promotional material, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
